meta.name: angular-module-design
meta.description: Design Angular modules using feature modules, lazy loading, and dependency injection. Use when organizing large Angular applications with proper separation of concerns.

copy.tagline: 组织大型 Angular 应用模块结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或规划大型 Angular 应用的模块划分。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or planning module organization for a large Angular app.

howto.what: 当用户请求设计Angular模块时，Claude会提供特性模块、懒加载、依赖注入等架构指导，并给出TypeScript代码示例。
howto.when: 当用户提出需要组织大型Angular应用，或涉及功能模块划分、路由懒加载、服务依赖注入等问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户管理的Angular特性模块。
say.note: Claude会生成特性模块的完整代码。

say.text: 如何在Angular中实现懒加载路由？
say.note: Claude会展示路由配置和模块拆分。

say.text: 请演示依赖注入在特性模块中的使用。

howto.what_en: When users request to design Angular modules, Claude provides architectural guidance on feature modules, lazy loading, dependency injection, etc., and gives TypeScript code examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users need to organize large Angular applications, or ask about feature module partitioning, lazy loading routes, service dependency injection, etc.

say_en.text: Help me design an Angular feature module for user management.
say_en.note: Claude generates the complete feature module code.

say_en.text: How to implement lazy loading routes in Angular?
say_en.note: Claude shows route configuration and module splitting.

say_en.text: Demonstrate dependency injection in a feature module.
